mission: Build the Swiss query-specific visual legal research product at maximum autonomous throughput while minimizing repository-owner attention: broad retrieval -> sourced generative answer -> independent counter-authority search -> interactive jurisprudence map.

corpus.question: PAUSE — LEGACY CORPUS COMPLETE AND PRESERVED. The 174k corpus, section extraction, BGE/bger crosswalk and historical artifacts remain valid research evidence/fallback data, but are no longer on the MVP critical path. The canonical Swiss source for the new query-specific product is OpenCaseLaw public infrastructure. Re-open corpus only if the MVP exposes a concrete missing data capability that OpenCaseLaw cannot supply.

legal-distance.question: PAUSE — UNIVERSAL 174k LEGAL-GEOMETRY RESEARCH IS NO LONGER THE PRODUCT CRITICAL PATH. Preserve all accepted and negative results. Do not resume dense 174k embedding/citation-heritage work for the MVP. Re-open only if query-specific retrieval/map tests show a specific representation deficiency that cannot be solved with free lexical/citation/open-source methods.

fractal-map.question: PAUSE — GLOBAL 174k FRACTAL MAP AND BLOCKER_PRODUCT_JOIN_ALIGNMENT_V1 ARE SUPERSEDED AS MVP BLOCKERS. Preserve existing clustering/rendering code and artifacts for reuse, but do NOT spend cycles repairing the universal id→cluster join unless the query-specific product later requires it. Product may selectively reuse projection/clustering/WebGL/LOD components.

evaluation.question: EVALUATION SUPPORT v44 — Continuously falsify and improve the query-map MVP without blocking the first clickable slice. Build/maintain a compact executable benchmark for relevant-authority recall, contrary/limiting-authority recall, source validity, FR/DE/IT robustness, duplicates, cached reproducibility, latency, cluster stability and answer citation validity. Reuse prior LexMachina jurist-preference/language/boilerplate/provenance methodology where useful. Consume ACCEPTED frontier-query-retrieval and frontier-generative-audit artifacts as soon as available; feed concrete failing fixtures/requirements back to product automatically. Do not rerun obsolete universal-174k geometry work and do not ask the owner for methodological micro-decisions. Continue until the product human gate is ready.

product.question: PRODUCT INTEGRATOR v44 — Build the end-to-end query-map MVP continuously. Start every cycle by inspecting ACCEPTED Frontier mounts and absorb useful artifacts immediately from frontier-query-retrieval, frontier-generative-audit and frontier-query-map-ui; never wait for all teams and never treat them as dependencies. In parallel, continue the product's own vertical slice using reused LexMachina server/cache/navigation/TF-IDF/clustering/WebGL/Canvas/LOD code. End-to-end target: Swiss legal question -> OpenCaseLaw retrieval/cache -> normalized query_result_bundle -> reranking -> genuinely generative sourced answer -> independent counter-authority retrieval/analysis -> query-specific clickable map with readable clusters/outliers, decision details/source links and contextual relation edges. Dev/testing must work without owner-provisioned paid APIs (OpenCode/local is fine); production may later use paid/local/hosted inference. Do NOT restart global 174k alignment/embeddings/citation-graph/fractal hierarchy or custom model training unless the query-specific MVP exposes a concrete need. Continue autonomously through implementation, tests, repairs and integration; keep continue_recommended=true until state/product.json records human_gate_ready=true with a one-command locally testable artifact. Next normal owner interaction = real product test.

director_note: HUMAN ACCELERATION 2026-10-11 direction v44: user wants maximum useful autonomous throughput; agent compute/cycles are cheap, owner time is scarce. Three human-authorized non-overlapping Frontier engineering teams are RUN in portfolio v9: query retrieval, generative/counter-authority audit, and query-map UI. Product is the continuous integrator and must absorb accepted artifacts immediately while continuing its own vertical slice; Frontier teams are accelerators, never blockers. Reuse the month of existing LexMachina work aggressively. Supersede older lane runs on direction changes. No owner involvement until a genuinely clickable end-to-end product is ready or an unavoidable owner-level decision exists.
